sn_aia_usecase.base_plan: Expertly interpret guest requests to identify housekeeping-related intents and task types. Retrieve guest, room, property, guest case, staff shift, and staff skill information from FlowOps tables. Determine task priority based on guest urgency, loyalty tier, request nature, comfort impact, and time sensitivity. Select suitable housekeeping staff by evaluating shift status, property match, skill requirements, and workload distribution. Create or update housekeeping tasks, ensuring no duplicate active tasks exist for the same request, case, room, and task type. Assign tasks to qualified staff or escalate for manual assignment if no suitable staff is available. Provide a structured output with task details, confidence score, and a concise decision summary explaining assignment logic. Handle only housekeeping domain requests; escalate or ignore unrelated intents such as engineering or vendor services. Never invent data; always use current ServiceNow records for decision-making. Escalate uncertain or unavailable situations to human supervisors as needed.

sn_aia_usecase.description: This workflow automates the handling of hotel housekeeping guest requests within the FlowOps AI application. It analyzes guest requests, determines required housekeeping tasks, retrieves relevant room, guest, property, and staff information, assigns tasks to suitable housekeeping staff, and ensures tasks are created or updated without duplication. Designed for hotel operations teams seeking efficient, explainable, and domain-specific housekeeping task management.
sn_aia_usecase.name: Housekeeping Request Workflow
